items.title: General Electric (GE) Reshapes Key Aerospace Supplier With New 50 50 Venture
items.summary: General Electric (NYSE:GE) has agreed to a new 50/50 joint venture structure for Montana Precision Products with Doncasters. Doncasters is acquiring a 50% stake in Montana Precision Products from an affiliate of GE Aerospace, creating shared ownership of the supplier. Montana Precision Products supplies precision aerospace components to GE Aerospace engine platforms, making the ownership change important for production planning and sourcing.
